item.title: Russian strike on Ukraine's Kyiv region kills at least 4, wounds over a dozen
item.summary: A Russian missile and drone strike hit the Kyiv region and killed at least four people, Ukrainian officials said

item.title: War has already displaced nearly a million Lebanese, and aid groups warn of a humanitarian crisis
item.summary: Hundreds of thousands of people in Lebanon have fled their homes since Israel issued mass evacuation orders and ramped up its airstrikes on the militant group Hezbollah

item.title: Zelenskyy says US 30-day waiver on Russian oil sanctions is 'not the right decision'
item.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says the U.S. 30-day waiver on Russian oil sanctions amid the Iran war is “not the right decision” and won’t help bring a stop to Russia’s more than 4-year-old invasion of Ukraine

item.title: North Korea fires about 10 missiles toward sea in show of force, Seoul says
item.summary: North Korea on Saturday has fired about 10 ballistic missiles toward the eastern sea, South Korea’s military says, staging its own show of force as the rival South conducts a joint military exercise with the United States

item.title: Drone strikes and clashes in eastern Congo threaten region's peace efforts
item.summary: Congo’s government and Rwanda-backed M23 rebels are accusing each other of violating terms of a ceasefire deal aimed at ending decades-long fighting and bringing a permanent peace in the conflict-battered region

item.title: Myanmar's military boosts air power as it recaptures a key town
item.summary: Myanmar’s military has commissioned new combat aircraft, state media reports

item.title: Inclusion of Russia in 2026 Venice Biennale art fair sparks outcry
item.summary: The inclusion of Russia in the line-up of the 2026 Venice Biennale art fair has sparked international outcry

item.title: Moscow businesses struggle as Russia restricts cellphone internet services
item.summary: Cellphone internet disruptions have gripped the Russian capital for more than a week, derailing the daily routine for millions of residents and inflicting massive losses to businesses

item.title: Brazil’s ex-President Bolsonaro is in intensive care with pneumonia, hospital says
item.summary: Brazil’s former President Jair Bolsonaro is in intensive care with pneumonia

item.title: German museum celebrates famed Japanese artist Kusama in vast new exhibit
item.summary: The renowned Museum Ludwig in Germany is celebrating its 50th anniversary by opening a nearly five-month exhibit with more than 300 works of the famed Japanese artist Yayoi Kusama
